processes.name: Supplier invoice exception resolution

boundary.ends_when: Finance records disposition and payment-review handoff
boundary.business_outcome: complete evidence supports review; posting and payment excluded

processes.membership_rationale: The two active records cover invoice intake and match-exception review within one invoice-resolution boundary.

linkage.rationale: The inventory omits the join column, but the customer workshop confirms invoice_id across the frozen intake and exception exports.
linkage.validation_step: An analyst verifies twenty joined records and documents every unmatched case before the workshop.

processes.name: Vendor onboarding evidence readiness

boundary.ends_when: Supplier Risk Lead records the review outcome
boundary.business_outcome: traceable risk decision supports onboarding; vendor-master creation excluded

processes.membership_rationale: The two active records represent supplier intake and evidence review within one onboarding-readiness decision path.

linkage.rationale: The inventory omits the join column, but the customer workshop confirms supplier_request_id across the frozen intake and risk-review exports.
linkage.validation_step: An analyst verifies twenty joined supplier records and documents every unmatched case before the workshop.

processes.name: Vendor master creation

boundary.starts_when: an approved supplier result is ready for master-data processing
boundary.ends_when: an authorized owner creates the supplier record in the replacement system
boundary.business_outcome: approved suppliers receive a controlled and auditable master record

processes.membership_rationale: The single paused record describes the distinct vendor master creation step after onboarding review.

linkage.rationale: Only one inventory record belongs to this paused process boundary.
linkage.validation_step: Procurement names the owner, restart trigger, replacement system, and authorized write path before reconsideration.

processes.name: Quarterly privileged access assurance

boundary.ends_when: Access Governance Manager records the certification decision
boundary.business_outcome: traceable evidence closes certification; access changes excluded

processes.membership_rationale: The two active records cover evidence extraction and exception preparation for the same quarterly access-assurance decision cycle.

linkage.rationale: The inventory omits the join columns, but the CIO workshop confirms campaign_id and entitlement_id across the frozen evidence and exception exports.
linkage.validation_step: An analyst verifies thirty joined exception records and documents every unmatched case before the workshop.

processes.name: Employee lifecycle requests

boundary.starts_when: HR receives an onboarding packet or benefits life-event request
boundary.ends_when: HR records completeness and routes the request to its human decision owner
boundary.business_outcome: complete employee-service submissions reach the correct HR reviewer with traceable context

processes.membership_rationale: Both records perform employee-service intake and completeness checks, but their shared operating boundary remains analytically weak.

linkage.rationale: The records share an HR intake pattern, but they have different outcomes and no stated common case model.
linkage.validation_step: HR reviews twenty records from each request type and decides whether one owner, taxonomy, and boundary apply.

unmapped_inventory.reason: The source marks this posting-confirmation archive retired and does not identify its replacement process.

stages.name: Existing invoice intake and worklist
stages.action: Capture invoice submissions and prepare purchase-order match exceptions for Finance review.
stages.human_control: Finance staff resolve current exception cases.

stages.name: links invoice ID
stages.action: Join frozen mailbox and worklist exports by invoice ID; log each case stage and wait reason.
stages.human_control: Finance approves the sampled boundary and checkpoints.

stages.name: outputs invoice and PO evidence gaps
stages.action: Output one invoice and purchase-order evidence bundle per case; flag missing IDs, match results, or documents.
stages.human_control: Finance staff inspect every compiled evidence package.

stages.name: Finance reviews weekly
stages.action: Compare every bundle with the Finance Operations Lead-approved final disposition in a weekly control review.
stages.human_control: The Finance Operations Lead is the reviewer of record for the historical truth set.

stages.name: Authorized result recording
stages.action: Record only a human-approved exception disposition after separate production authorization.
stages.human_control: A separately authorized human-approved result is required.

maestro.role: Coordinates historical case stages, waits, and reviewer checkpoints during the shadow.

agentic.role: The first pilot tests deterministic evidence rules before considering adaptive judgment.

genai.role: The pilot uses source-grounded structured summaries and creates no generated external content.

robots.role: Compile historical evidence read-only and support only separately authorized future recording.

human_review.role: Finance reviewers retain every exception and production-change decision.

metrics.name: agreement
metrics.formula: reviewed cases whose proposed route matches final disposition / reviewed cases

metrics.name: linkage
metrics.formula: cases joined by invoice ID / reviewed cases

measurement_plan.mixed_result_action: Correct rules or linkage, rerun failed cases, and do not proceed until every gate passes.

next_step.action: Prerequisite: Finance data owner approves export and baseline; UiPath validates product/deployment fit; otherwise defer

stages.name: Existing supplier intake and review
stages.action: Capture supplier requests and prepare submitted evidence for Procurement risk review.
stages.human_control: Procurement reviewers decide current supplier exceptions.

stages.name: links supplier request ID
stages.action: Join frozen portal and risk-review exports by supplier request ID; log each handoff and wait.
stages.human_control: Procurement approves the sample boundary and handoffs.

stages.name: outputs checklist and document gaps
stages.action: Output one checklist result per file; flag missing required documents against the approved taxonomy.
stages.human_control: Procurement reviewers inspect every classification and retain every disposition.

stages.name: Procurement reviews weekly
stages.action: Compare every result with the Supplier Risk Lead-approved checklist and reviewer-of-record outcome in a weekly control review.
stages.human_control: The Supplier Risk Lead owns the checklist and historical truth set.

maestro.role: Coordinates supplier-file stages, waits, human checkpoints, and exception paths.

agentic.role: The first pilot tests established evidence rules and does not require adaptive support.

genai.role: The first pilot uses structured rule results and creates no generated content.

robots.role: Apply approved evidence rules to redacted historical files without changing source systems.

human_review.role: Procurement reviewers retain document, risk, supplier, and production-change decisions.

measurement_plan.sample_method: 80 completed redacted files by unit and class
measurement_plan.ground_truth: Approved checklist and outcome per file

metrics.name: precision
metrics.formula: correct missing-document flags / all missing-document flags

metrics.name: recall
metrics.formula: known missing documents correctly flagged / all known missing documents

measurement_plan.mixed_result_action: Correct rules or linkage, rerun failed files, and do not proceed until every gate passes.

next_step.action: Prerequisite: Supplier Risk Lead approves redacted export and baseline; UiPath validates product/deployment fit; otherwise defer

stages.human_control: IT assurance approves the sample and checkpoints.

stages.name: outputs evidence-gap bundles

stages.human_control: Assurance staff inspect every compiled evidence package.

stages.name: Assurance reviews weekly
